output.summary: Backlog growth is mostly artificial. Created volume rose 66% from June to October, but first-contact issues rose only 4%; split children, customer duplicates and reopens account for nearly all the backlog growth, while original first-contact tickets in the backlog fell. The reopen rise is real: the auto-reopen trigger is unchanged and courtesy replies stay near 5%. Capacity loss, lower effort, Payroll-driven demand and a measurement artifact are contradicted as main drivers. Quota-induced premature closing, splitting and quick-picking is supported by mechanism, survey, system data and a no-quota contrast pod. Raising the quota, or approving 12 irreversible hires now, is not justified. Suspend the quota, adopt quality measures, and classify aged complex tickets to test the unresolved bug-blocking share.
